source_snapshot.comparison: Exact-row DeepSeek and GPT V2 were checked against Master semantics.

historical_reviews.history: Neighboring records and target-specific semantics checked.

original_test_intent: Inject one approved synthetic reading/event state into a vendor-supported controllable sensor, observe consumers, then return normal ownership.
original_method: Original Master source is retained verbatim; Review adds a safe bounded method.
manual_activity: Owner chooses a dedicated non-production target, exact controllable sensor/value/status, duration and restoration.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the bounded approved command
engineer_actions: Approve inputs, limits and recovery; own DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not accepted blindly; missing fields, credential handling and semantic coverage were corrected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture 0x2D/0x2B baseline, issue one fully specified 0x04/0x30 request, observe monitoring/SEL, then restore normal sensor ownership and verify.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fields/timing are preserved and absent bytes are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture 0x2D/0x2B baseline, issue one fully specified 0x04/0x30 request, observe monitoring/SEL, then restore normal sensor ownership and verify.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects execution and acceptance only in Review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A read-only sensor get is not write/injection coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Synthetic values can trigger policy actions or mask a real sensor.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are allowed only with approved equivalence and explicit disclosure of unverified original-tool/raw-command coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master mixes IB/OOB and omits reading/status bytes, ownership, range and recovery; success-only criterion and log clearing are unsafe.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is identifiable; target values and approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Replaces the incomplete write with a vendor-qualified stimulus lifecycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Set Sensor Reading and Event Status is not a generic read; it transfers or exercises sensor state ownership. Missing operation/status/data bytes make the Master request non-executable, and a high-level read cannot satisfy the mutation. Safety depends on a controllable sensor, bounded stimulus and verified release.
